thread:
talia: kicking off sunset embed onboarding (int4-adaptive fallback). 4-fold holdout, per-channel quant by default. running recall+silhouette+idflip checks. will post quick smoke.

ben: nice — please include baseline comparison (lucent-f16) and any per-cohort deltas.

talia: smoke numbers: recall@1 0.66, recall@5 0.82, recall@10 0.88, silhouette_avg 0.34, idflip_k1 0.009. baseline lucent-f16 recall@1 0.73 silhouette 0.50.

orma: idflip ~0.9% is high. which cohorts? short-query or devdocs?

talia: quick cohort check: short-query delta -0.08 @1, devdocs -0.03, longtail unchanged. UMAP shows short queries scattering toward border.

ben: try whitening + l2 renorm ablation and a per-tensor quant run. also run int4-adaptive where rare tokens fallback to int8.

talia: kicked off whitening run and int4-fallback job. eval-bot uploading artifacts when done.

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-evals/sunset/onboard/4455554321/ (recall_csv, umap_before.png, umap_whiten.png, anchor_drift.csv).

talia: next steps: 1) compare per-channel vs per-tensor, 2) run int4-adaptive fallback on short-query subset, 3) PQ tuning for flat vs pq index. will propose gating: block canary if idflip_k1 > 0.5% or recall@1 delta > 0.03.

orma: +1 on gating; also add multilingual holdout if we see short-query variance.

ben: thanks — ping when whitening numbers in; if whitening recovers silhouette and idflip drops we'll re-run full k-fold stability.

talia: will do, posting updates here. :thumbsup:
